title: fieldwork::peertube_api — PeerTube Client API route handlers
description: Axum route handlers implementing PeerTube API endpoints. Completely different schema from Mastodon. Endpoints: /api/v1/videos, /api/v1/video-channels, /api/v1/videos/{id}/comment-threads, /api/v1/users/me/video-playlists, /api/v1/jobs. Reusable by all three servers.
